title: Expected width of a selected DNF term
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\varphi$ be a disjunctive normal form on the sign cube $\{−1,1\}^n$, and let $s$ be a nonnegative integer such that the number of terms of $\varphi$ is at most $s$. The uniform expectation over inputs $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$ of the width of the selected term is at most $\lceil\log_2 s\rceil+1$, where the selected term is the one chosen when $\varphi(x)=-1$ and is the empty term otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a DNF on the sign cube
The number of terms of $\varphi$ is at most $s$
